Rule 66/91: καύσων is the burning heat itself — the ASV's standing word for the lexeme is scorching, while the noun it completes it with varies (heat elsewhere, wind here for the sirocco) — so scorching glosses the lexeme and wind is the supplied generic completion; head on scorching. Heading on wind is the competing reading, defensible if one reads scorching wind as a single English gloss, but rule 17 forbids choosing wind merely because it is the phrase's formal head.

Rule 49: where the article's complement is an adjective nothing else can carry the determiner, so the supplied generic noun is the article's own, as τὸ τρίτον gives the ... part to the article; the discontinuous the ... man is one unit under rule 15. Head corrected from the to man: rule 22 says an article unit that brings its own determiner is still headed on the nominal word and never the determiner, naming τὸ → the part, and rule 60 repeats it for τῆς μελλούσης → that hour which heading on hour. Rule 17's on the → the is not the contrast, no case preposition being in question here. Giving man to πλούσιος on the analogy of rule 66's covetous man is the competing reading, but that precedent is anarthrous and no article stood there to take the determiner.
The adjective keeps a bare rich, as third does in rule 49's τὸ τρίτον.

Rules 9 and 15: the future auxiliary shall is discontinuous from fade away but is the verb's own inflection-licensed helper; rule 17 heads on the lexical verb, and away is the English verb's own particle, no Greek preposition standing for it under rule 36.

review_notes: Corrected one head. s026 ὁ → the ... man now heads on man (t032) rather than the (t030). The edges were right — rule 49 gives the supplied generic noun to the article where its complement is an adjective — but rule 22 fixes the head inside such a unit on the nominal word and never on the determiner, naming τὸ → the part in terms, and rule 60 confirms it for τῆς μελλούσης → that hour which. Rule 17's on the → the applies only where a case preposition realizes the article's case, which is not this construction.
Everything else is unchanged. Every s001–s032 and t001–t037 id is used exactly once; each single-token unit takes its own source head.

Two contested heads are noted in place: καύσωνι → scorching wind (rule 66/91 head on scorching, against a head on wind), and ὁ πλούσιος → the rich man, where rule 49 puts the supplied generic noun on the article against the competing reading that gives man to πλούσιος on rule 66's anarthrous covetous man.

The three αὐτοῦ tokens are handled by rule 20's availability test: thereof (s015) and of it (s022) are the pronoun's own English and leave their articles the ordinary the, while the possessive his (s031) empties s029.
